description_en: Adds access addresses to a directional group
description_zh: 给定向分组添加访问地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkcard batch-add-directional-address --group-id 5 --source user_defined --address-type Domain --list-address 0.aliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchAddDirectionalAddress

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the directional group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html operation to obtain the directional group ID (DirectionalGroupId) from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
定向分组ID。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html在返回参数中查看定向分组ID（DirectionalGroupId）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The address source. Valid values:

user_defined: user-defined.

aliyun_defined: Alibaba Cloud predefined
parameters.help_zh:
地址来源。

user_defined：用户配置。

aliyun_defined：阿里云预配
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:

Ip: IP address.

Domain: domain name
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型。

Ip：IP地址。

Domain：域名
parameters.name: address_type

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call was successful.

Other codes: The call failed. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：调用成功。

其他：调用失败。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the addresses were added. Valid values:

true: The addresses were added.

false: The addresses failed to be added
Data.description_zh:
地址是否添加成功。

true：添加成功。

false：添加失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:

true：调用成功。
